correctness.rationale: For n>=7 any nonedge of G_n is a consecutive pair in C_n; its common neighbors on shortest 2-paths include all but two vertices, and applying the same forced-geodesic closure to two consecutive interior pairs forces those last two. Therefore any proper convex set is a clique of G_n, equivalently an ordinary cycle independent set, and the full graph is the unique exceptional top hypothesis. A set T with at least three vertices containing a cycle edge cannot shatter the trace {u,v}: only the exceptional top contains both endpoints; independent T and all |T|<=2 shatter. This yields Phi_n=I(C_n;z)+nz², VC floor(n/2). For online dimension, Ind(F) has Ldim alpha(F), and the augmented-path with a positive exceptional top/marker has Ldim floor(m/2)+1 by endpoint first-query induction and branch bounds. First query v in the cycle induces negative Ind(P_{n-1}) and positive augmented P_{n-3}, giving Ldim=1+min(ceil((n-1)/2),floor((n-3)/2)+1)=ceil(n/2). Independently enumerated all convex traces and recursive version-space Littlestone trees for n=7..11, reproducing odd gap one and even gap zero; this is support for the infinite structural induction.
